description: NTRevo - Nền tảng phục hồi thể lực thích ứng thông minh (MVP FR-01 to FR-07)

userStories.title: Data models and storage schema for biometrics and recovery logs
userStories.description: As a developer, I need unified data models and local persistence for morning biometrics, muscle soreness logs, and readiness scores.
acceptanceCriteria: Create BiometricsLog, DomsLog, and ReadinessResult data schemas
Implement persistent storage helpers (save/load/history)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Completed data schemas and NTRevoStorage persistence helpers with 100% test coverage.

userStories.title: Morning biometrics check-in form (FR-01)
userStories.description: As an athlete, I want to quickly log sleep hours, sleep quality, resting heart rate, and stress level every morning.
acceptanceCriteria: Sliders and rating controls for sleep duration, sleep quality, RHR bpm, and stress level
Input validation prevents out-of-range biometrics (RHR 30-150 bpm, sleep 0-14h)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser
userStories.notes: Built Athletic Dark Mode morning biometrics check-in with range sliders, star ratings, and real-time validation.

userStories.title: Interactive DOMS muscle soreness map (FR-02)
userStories.description: As an athlete, I want to tap on sore muscle groups on an interactive anatomical body map and select pain intensity (1-10).
acceptanceCriteria: Interactive anatomical SVG body map with major muscle groups (chest, back, shoulders, quads, hamstrings, calves)
Clicking a muscle opens pain rating slider (1-10) and applies visual heat-map styling
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser
userStories.notes: Implemented interactive anatomical SVG body map (front and back views), DOMS modal rating (1-10), and soreness list.

userStories.title: AI Readiness Score engine calculation (FR-03)
userStories.description: As an athlete, I want an instant Readiness Score (0-100) calculated from weighted biometrics and DOMS fatigue.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement Readiness formula: HRV/RHR (15%), Sleep (30%), Stress (20%), DOMS penalty (35%)
Categorize output into 3 zones: Optimal (80-100 Green), Caution (50-79 Yellow), Danger (<50 Red)
Calculation executes in under 500ms
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Adaptive recovery protocol generator (FR-04)
userStories.description: As an athlete with sore muscles, I want AI to generate targeted mobility exercises, foam rolling protocols, and hydration advice.
acceptanceCriteria: Generate targeted recovery routine based on selected DOMS muscle groups
Display exercise duration, equipment, and step-by-step instructions
Provide electrolyte and hydration recommendations matching fatigue level
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser

userStories.title: Early overtraining risk warning system (FR-05)
userStories.description: As an athlete and coach, I want an immediate warning alert when Readiness is below 40 for two consecutive days.
acceptanceCriteria: Detect consecutive days with Readiness Score < 40
Display prominent visual warning banner: Cảnh báo nguy cơ quá tải / chấn thương
Suggest 50% training volume reduction or active rest
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser

userStories.title: Recovery trends and analytics visualization (FR-06)
userStories.description: As an athlete, I want to see visual trend charts of my readiness, sleep, and heart rate over 7 to 30 days.
acceptanceCriteria: Multi-line or bar charts displaying 7-day and 30-day historical metrics
Correlate sleep duration with readiness score changes
Fully responsive on mobile and desktop views
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser

userStories.title: Coach summary and weekly report export (FR-07)
userStories.description: As an athlete, I want to export my weekly recovery report in Markdown or printable view to review with my personal coach.
acceptanceCriteria: Export button compiles weekly averages, peak fatigue points, and muscle soreness summary
Support direct Markdown file download and printable clean layout
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser
